items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: And this is Gilbert Murr and his queen.

ctx.x: Two great grandchildren. Yes, indeed. Now this is taking at one of our T's.

This is the audience. One of our T's. Now I'm going to show you what the first mademoiselle, my little grand dog, rode in. Instead of a carriage, she rode under the number one. You see? She rode under the number one. Yeah, this is Sylvia too. And this is Sylvia again. I've got enough of her to remember. I don't blame you though. Yes, so they're going to be remembered. And this is me when I was too fat. And I was too fat, but the doctor fixed me. He's pulling me down. Yeah, I was too fat then. Who is this? Oh,…
